body.name: selector-correction transition
body.construction: Write \(\zeta\Rightarrow_{\mathrm{sc}}\zeta'\) iff the least \(\sigma=(s,X,r,x_s)\in\Sigma\) satisfies \(s\in H\), the stored gate has intervention status one with value \(x_s\), its labelled occurrence in \(K_{s,D}\) is present, and the context kernel initialized as \(p_H(V,S=s)/p_H(S=s)\) carries the selector normalizer \(p_H(S=s)=\sum_v p_H(v,s)\) in \(\mathcal D_H^{\mathrm{sc}}\). Replace that occurrence by \(\mathbf 1\{X=x_s\}\), substitute \(x_s\) in its children, append the corresponding linear coordinate-copy equations to \(\mathcal J\), remove exactly \(\sigma\), and change no earlier state component. The gate rewrite itself introduces no new division. The transition emits the rewritten labelled circuit. Its local obligations are the polynomial identity of the old and rewritten context kernels modulo the known zero-one gate equations and the recorded identity for the selector normalizer.
